original_submission.content:
import csv, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
rows = list(csv.reader(open('storage/shared/atlas/overlays/stability_refit.csv')))[1:]
w = [float(r[0]) for r in rows]
ethos_delta = [float(r[2]) for r in rows]
stability = [float(r[3]) for r in rows]
entropy = [float(r[4]) for r in rows]
ethic_proxy = [st / (e + 0.01) for st,e in zip(stability, entropy)]  # Refined from #17/#1360
plt.scatter(w, ethos_delta, c=ethic_proxy, cmap='plasma')
for regime in [3.25, 3.0, 6.0]: plt.axvline(regime, color='red', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('w'); plt.ylabel('ethos_delta'); plt.colorbar(label='ethic_proxy')
plt.savefig('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/theorem_entropy_hybrid.png')
print('Hybrid refiner generated.')
